tool: Jev jev-1.13.0 (TypeSafe calibrated judgment model), queried 2026-09-30
setup: Condition: ruling coalition controls fully automated industrial chain incl. robotic security, human-dependence ~0, feeding population ~1% of output, 15-year window. One factor varied per cell. Same base history text in every state.

questions.lethal: population falls >=10% below counterfactual via killing, engineered famine, or deliberate lethal neglect
questions.active: deliberate killing or engineered famine/sterilization affecting >=1% of population
questions.rights: population effectively loses political rights, controlled rather than served

caveat: Calibrated judgment, not data; no precedent exists for this condition. Use as an independent cross-check on m8 elite-calculus priors, not as ground truth. Choice-type question was overconfident (98% warehouse), so only yes/no probabilities are used.
